## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

[法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s (Xiánshǒu Fǎzàng, 643–712) single-fascicle commentary on [KR6n0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0089) *Dàshèng fǎjiè wú chābié lùn* 大乘法界無差別論 (T31n1626) — the short Tathāgatagarbha treatise attributed to Sāramati and translated by [提雲般若](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%8F%90%E9%9B%B2%E8%88%AC%E8%8B%A5) (Devaprajñā) c. 690–691. Fǎzàng was himself part of Devaprajñā's translation team and presumably composed this commentary shortly after the translation campaign. The work is a foundational Hua-yan-school text on the Tathāgatagarbha doctrine.

**Abstract**

Fǎzàng (the third patriarch of the Hua-yan 華嚴 school) was the author of more than thirty doctrinal works, including the foundational *Huáyán jīng tànxuán jì* 華嚴經探玄記 (T1733), the *Wǔ jiào zhāng* 五教章 (T1866), and the parabolic *Jīnshīzǐ zhāng* 金獅子章 (T1880). His commentary on the *Dharmadhātu-aviśeṣa* short treatise is one of his shorter doctrinal works but is theologically central to the Hua-yan-school synthesis of Tathāgatagarbha and Avataṃsaka doctrines. Fǎzàng treats Sāramati's text as a key locus for the Hua-yan position that the *dharmadhātu* — the realm of all phenomena viewed in their ultimate inter-penetrating nature — is identifiable with the universal Buddha-nature.

The dating bracket adopted (691–712) covers the period from the completion of Devaprajñā's translation (in which Fǎzàng participated) to Fǎzàng's death. The colophons do not give a precise date.

The work is one of the principal Tang-dynasty Tathāgatagarbha-tradition commentaries and is the textual foundation for the Sòng-period sub-commentaries [KR6n0092](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0092) *Dàshèng fǎjiè wú chābié lùn shū lǐngyào chāo kē* and [KR6n0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0093) *Dàshèng fǎjiè wú chābié lùn shū lǐngyào chāo* by [普觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E8%A7%80) of the Sòng dynasty.
